q: Which group has the most named species?
About how many named species of plants are there?
About what fraction of all the named species shown are insects?
Total about 2 170 000; insects 1 000 000 is about 46%, nearly half.
Scientists think there are many more fungi than have been named. Suggest two reasons why so few fungi have been named.
Many fungi are microscopic or live hidden underground or inside other organisms; they look alike, so DNA tests are often needed; fewer scientists study fungi than animals or plants.
